elevenlabsPrompt:
[firm] Every new app asks to track you? Stop the pop-ups.

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn off tracking requests.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Privacy and Security. Tap Tracking. Turn off Allow Apps to Request to Track.

[delighted] No more pop-ups. Every app gets told no automatically.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
